verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own API documents a 'Merge two persons' endpoint (PUT /api/v1/persons/{id}/merge), so merging duplicate contacts is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows duplicate detection, merging companies or organizations, a UI merge flow for ops users, or how field data is kept during a merge. missing for 10: duplicate detection/suggestions, organization/company merge, in-app (non-API) merge workflow, documentation of data preservation on merge, independent corroboration.
